label: BATTER-TPE compatibility pilot
description: Regional output from the official BATTER-TPE pretrained model under a documented compatibility environment. Intervals are model-predicted transcript 3-prime-end candidates, not experimentally measured endpoints.
coordinate_conversion: BATTER output coordinates were BED 0-based relative to the extracted region; 17999 was added to start and end to restore NC_000964.3 genome coordinates.
edge_exclusion: All 11 retained intervals are at least 861 nt from either edge of the 10001-nt pilot input.
output_format: BED-like 7-column output: chrom, start, end, id, model_score, strand, estimated_false_positives_per_kb

runtime.model_compatibility_adjustment: The isolated execution copy loaded the official state dict with strict=False because newer transformers registers encoder.embeddings.position_ids as an extra buffer; the only reported mismatch was this unexpected buffer. The CRF view operations were changed to reshape for torch 2.11 tensor contiguity compatibility. Official repository files were not modified.

compatibility_sanity_check.matching_intervals: 6 of 7 reference intervals in the 1-6000 region matched exactly (coordinates, strand and score).
compatibility_sanity_check.known_difference: The reference interval NC_000913.3:5032-5075 (+, score 0.902) was emitted as NC_000913.3:5036-5078 (+, score 0.912) under the compatibility environment; the other six intervals matched exactly.
compatibility_sanity_check.interpretation: This supports that the official model and output format are wired correctly, but the run is labelled a compatibility pilot rather than an exact reproduction of the authors' legacy environment.

limitations: This is a regional pilot, not a genome-wide BATTER run.
BATTER-TPE intervals and scores are computational predictions; they must not be merged into the experimental endpoint table.
The model output does not establish an exact single-base transcription end.
No C-layer augmentation track is included in this pilot.
